Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 -- Added on 05/13/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 ---------- 
if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date > chp_sysdate then
 show_error('18014');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;

if :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date > :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date then
 show_error('7023');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;

END;

 End;

 Procedure change_status is

 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_more',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_def_detail',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_drive_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_set_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_tran_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_def_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_donor_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE); 
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_insert_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_user_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_don_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 set_application_property(cursor_style,'busy');

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_def_id is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_set is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id is null and

 v_where:=' coll_date between sysdate-15 and sysdate and deferral_id is not null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ';
 set_block_property('donations',default_where,v_where); 

 SELECT nvl(count(*),0) into :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count from donations where
 coll_date between sysdate-15 and sysdate and deferral_id is not null;
 ELSE
 
 go_block('donations');
 
 set_block_property('donations',default_where ,
 ' drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)' ||
 ' and deferral_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_def_id,deferral_id)' ||
 ' and set_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_set,set_id)'||
 ' and transaction_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id,transaction_id)' ||
 ' and insert_user=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_temp_user,insert_user)'||
 ' and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,coll_date) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,coll_date)'||
 ' and deferral_id is not null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ');
 
 SELECT nvl(count(*),0) into :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count from donations where

 transaction_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id,transaction_id) and
 insert_user=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_user_id,insert_user) and
 coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,coll_date) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,coll_date) and 
 deferral_id is not null;
 
 END IF;

 execute_query;
 last_record;
 first_record;

 if :donations.deferral_id is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date');
 else
 enable_disable('D');
 change_status; 
 end if;

END;

 chp_sysdate date;
 procedure change_status is
 begin
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_dnr_holds',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_more',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_def_detail',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 procedure add_and(pl_string in out varchar2) is
 begin
 if pl_string is not null then
 pl_string:=pl_string||' and ';
 else
 pl_string:=null;
 end if;
 end;

BEGIN
 -- Added on 05/13/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 ---------- 
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'busy');
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id is null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_def_id is null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_set is null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id is null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_user_id is null then

 go_block('donations');
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date:=chp_sysdate-:global.lov_limit;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date:=chp_sysdate;

 v_where := ' coll_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date ' || 
 ' and deferral_id is not null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ';
 set_block_property('donations',default_where,v_where); 

 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null and 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is null and 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_def_id is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_set is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id is null and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_user_id is not null then

 go_block('donations');
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date:=chp_sysdate-:global.lov_limit;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date:=chp_sysdate;

 v_where := ' coll_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date ' || 
 ' and deferral_id is not null and insert_user=:ctrl_blk_1.s_user_id and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ';
 set_block_property('donations',default_where,v_where); 

 ELSE
 go_block('donations');

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is not null then
 add_and(v_string);
 v_string := 'coll_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_def_id is not null then
 add_and(v_string);
 v_string := v_string || 'deferral_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_def_id ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id is not null then
 add_and(v_string);
 v_string := v_string || ' drive_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id is not null then
 add_and(v_string);
 v_string := v_string || ' transaction_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_set is not null then
 add_and(v_string); 
 v_string := v_string || ' set_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_set ';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_user_id is not null then
 add_and(v_string);
 v_string := v_string || ' insert_user = :ctrl_blk_1.s_user_id';
 end if;

 v_string := v_string || ' and deferral_id is not null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ';
 set_block_property('donations',default_where,v_string); 
 ---- message(v_string);pause; 
 END IF;

 execute_query;
 last_record;
 :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count := tot_no_of_records; ---tot_no_of_records is a function 
 first_record;

 set_application_property(cursor_style,'default');
 if :donations.deferral_id is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date');
 else
 enable_disable('D');
 change_status; 
 end if;

 if :donations.n_audit_flag is null then
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_def_detail',enabled,property_false);
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_def_detail',enabled,property_true);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOT_NO_OF_RECORDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION tot_no_of_records RETURN NUMBER IS
 v_count number:=0;
BEGIN
 go_block('donations');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :donations.deferral_id is not null then
 v_count:=v_count+1;
 end if;

 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 return v_count;
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ENTRY_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE entry_details IS
 v_ssn number;
 v_abo varchar2(5);
 v_ethnic_group varchar2(5);

BEGIN
 go_block('don_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('dnr_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);

 show_window('window2');
 go_block('don_block');
 go_item('don_block.pb_close');

 :don_block.deferral_id := :donations.deferral_id;
 :don_block.donor_id := :donations.donor_id;

 begin
 select a.last_name,a.last_name_suffix, a.first_name, a.middle_name, ssn, 
 a.date_of_birth, a.gender, a.blood_type, a.ethnic_group, 
 b.street_name, b.suite_apt, b.d_area_code, b.d_phone_no, b.extension,
 b.h_area_code, b.h_phone_no, b.email, c.state, c.city, c.zip 
 into :dnr_block.last_name,:dnr_block.last_name_suffix, :dnr_block.first_name, 
 :dnr_block.middle_name, v_ssn,:dnr_block.date_of_birth,
 :dnr_block.gender, v_abo, v_ethnic_group,
 :dnr_block.street_name, :dnr_block.suite_apt, :dnr_block.d_area_code,
 :dnr_block.d_phone_no, :dnr_block.extension, :dnr_block.h_area_code,
 :dnr_block.h_phone_no, :dnr_block.email, 
 :dnr_block.state, :dnr_block.city, :dnr_block.zip
 from donors a, donor_addresses b, valid_city_state c 
 where a.donor_id = :donations.donor_id 
 and b.donor_id = a.donor_id 
 and c.usps_id = b.usps_id;

 :dnr_block.ssn := to_char(floor(v_ssn/1000000),'099')||'-'||
 ltrim(to_char(floor(mod(v_ssn,1000000)/10000),'09'))||'-'||
 ltrim(to_char(mod(v_ssn,10000),'0999'));
 :dnr_block.ssn := ltrim(:dnr_block.ssn);

 begin
 select description 
 into :dnr_block.blood_type 
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type = 'ABO' 
 and code = v_abo;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 :dnr_block.blood_type := 'No ABO';
 end;

 /*
 begin
 select description 
 into :dnr_block.ethnic_group
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type = 'ETHGP' 
 and code = v_ethnic_group;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 :dnr_block.ethnic_group := 'No Ethnic Grp';
 end;
 */

 :dnr_block.ethnic_group :=v_ethnic_group;

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 begin
 select credit_sponsor, lookup_id, screener_id, physical_id 
 into :don_block.credit_sponsor, :don_block.lookup_id,
 :don_block.screener_id, :don_block.physical_id 
 from donations 
 where transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 begin
 select a.donation_type, a.procedure_code, a.deferral_reason, a.deferred_thru_date,
 a.transaction_id, a.first_reviewer_id, b.drive_date 
 into :don_block.donation_type, :don_block.procedure_code,
 :don_block.deferral_reason, :don_block.deferred_thru_date,
 :don_block.transaction_id, :don_block.first_reviewer_id, :don_block.drive_date
 from donations a, drives b 
 where a.transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id 
 and b.drive_id = a.drive_id;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

---------------------------
 begin
 select A.Employer_name, b.zip, b.city, b.state
 into :dnr_block.Employer_name, :dnr_block.e_zip, 
 :dnr_block.e_city, :dnr_block.e_state
 from donor_employers a, valid_city_state b
 where a.employer_id = (select employer_id 
 from donors 
 where donor_id = :donations.donor_id) 
 and a.usps_id = b.usps_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

END;

PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_trans_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.transaction_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_unit_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.deferral_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_def_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.deferral_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 

 if p_window_name='DRWHOLDS' then
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_coll_date', TEXT_PARAMETER, to_char(:donations.coll_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 end if;

 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

DECLARE
 l_chp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
